messages.subject: New user....
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I don't want to write a lot... I'm new user from Switzerland...
I just begin using R and try to learn more about Bayesian Network and
deal.

I see on "	http://www.math.aau.dk/~dethlef/novo/deal" that there is a
way to simulate "datasets with a given dependency structure". I try to
 create some data set first of only discrete variable.

Is there any document, examples or advice for that?
I just tried with "bindata" but is there another way?

Thanks a lot for reading me and I hope I'm not too anoying ;o)

Greetings from Lausanne,

Mélanie Cicognani
